title: Christmas New Year Seasonal Smart Mockup Bundle
author: PorlawatSangyoo
description:
Christmas New Year Seasonal Smart Mockup Bundle
Give a professional touch to your arts, designs, drawing, selling your graphic designs without the hassle of photographing each one.
Selling your arts for Christmas designs theme professionally with our supreme Christmas Mockup Bundles.
You can display your design and how it works on these t-shirts & sweatshirt to sell your POD graphics, making it ideal for customers to interest more!
Add your own image and graphic
All templates are ready to use, just simply add in your own art files. 
File formats included:
– Photoshop CC .PSD file. File is set up with Smart Objects.
– JPG files for any programs so you can easily apply your art on top of the image.
Template sizes:
– PSD: 5000 x 3333pixels & 5000 x 4000pixels
– JPG: 3750 x 2500pixels & 3750 x 3000pixels
What you’ll get from this bundle:
24 mockup templates
2 PSD + 2 JPG per template
Total: 96 files
Get this great bundle for just $5 and save $91!
